resume: Music toy for very young children, a fork of Felucca: 94 friends, each with a picture, a sound, a sky and a favorite rhythm, one color per note, 21 rhythms with a bass that is always right. Always starts in Rainbow mode.

commandes.role: Same effect as KNOB 1: a bigger friend, lower notes.
Same effect as KNOB 1: a smaller friend, higher notes.
SLEEPY: the sound slows down with each note; wakes up by itself after 3 seconds.
SQUEAKY: everything goes up an octave.
GIANT: everything goes down an octave.
A surprise friend. Held for one second: the VOLUME for adults.
WRITE: you write your own song; SAVE again returns to play.
Sparkle: a held key rises and falls by itself.
Starts and stops the rhythm: drums and bass always in key.
Volume, within the limit chosen by the adults.
Slower or faster rhythm (SLOW, WALK, FAST).
Way of playing: 1 FRIEND, 3 FRIENDS, STRUM, ACCORDION, GUESS, FOLLOW, CHORDS, COPY ME.
Play the friend's sound; the note letter is shown large.

gestes: HOME held 1 s: volume and settings for adults.
HOME and SAVE together 3 s: back to the full Felucca.

modes.texte: 1 FRIEND: one note per key. 3 FRIENDS: one chord per key. STRUM and ACCORDION: the black keys choose a chord. GUESS, FOLLOW, CHORDS and COPY ME are ear and memory games.
SAVE opens a large 32-column staff to write a song for up to three friends; PLAY plays it in a loop.

a_savoir: The top row effects switch on with one press and off with another, one at a time.
